**Important: YOU MUST USE subagents when available for the task.**

Stack: Laravel 12.0/PHP 8.2+, React 19/TypeScript, Mantine 7.17/Tailwind CSS 4.0, Inertia.js 2.0 with SSR, Filament 3.3, SQLite (multiple databases configured), Vite 6.0/Laravel Vite Plugin, PHPUnit 11.5, Laravel Pint, ESLint, Prettier, Tabler Icons React, Ziggy, Carbon. Full-stack SPA; Breeze authentication; Vite HMR and concurrent development server.

Use `<REDACTED_USER>` subagents for Laravel backend, React, UI/UX, API/architecture, reviews, performance, Filament, authentication, database, frontend state, and testing. Use `<REDACTED_USER>` + `<REDACTED_USER>` for full-stack/Inertia integration.

<!-- BACKLOG.MD GUIDELINES START -->
Task Markdown: `backlog/tasks/`; drafts: `backlog/drafts/`; docs: `backlog/docs/`; decisions: `backlog/decisions/`.
Every implementation decision starts with reading the corresponding Markdown task file.
All task operations should be done via Backlog.md CLI tool, this will correctly update the metadata in the task files and keep the project in sync. NO OPERATIONS SHOULD BE DONE MANUALLY ON THE TASK FILES.
Always use `--plain` flag when listing or viewing tasks for AI-friendly text output instead of using Backlog.md
When users mention one or multiple tasks, they are probably suggesting to use Backlog.md CLI tool.
Ask questions to the user if something is not clear or ambiguous. Break down tasks that are too large or complex. Use a clear brief title and concise purpose/goal summary without implementation details or code snippets.

Define specific, measurable outcomes. Acceptance Criteria (AC) must be outcome-oriented, testable, clear, complete, and user-focused where applicable—not step-by-step implementation. Example: `- [ ] User can successfully log in with valid credentials.`

Tasks are stored as `task-<id> - <title>.md`. Split features foundation-first, in dependency order; each task must deliver value independently, be atomic and testable, and represent one PR. Avoid blocking/dependent tasks; multiple tasks must be independent.
**Never** reference tasks that are to be done in the future or that are not yet created. You can only reference tasks (id < current task id).

Task description: short, imperative goal and why needed. Include outcomes as checkboxes, e.g.:
[ ] Resolver returns correct data for happy path
[ ] Error response matches REST
[ ] P95 latency ≤ 50 ms under 100 RPS

Implementation plan example:
1. Research existing GraphQL resolver patterns
2. Implement basic resolver with error handling
3. Add performance monitoring
4. Write unit and integration tests
5. Benchmark performance under load

Document features implemented/modified, technical decisions/trade-offs, and modified/added files.

Mandatory sections:
**Implementation Plan**: the “how”; add only after putting the task in progress and before starting work.
**Implementation Notes**: add after work; begin with a brief implementation summary, approach, decisions, challenges, and deviations. Keep concise and cover core changes only.

**IMPORTANT**: Do not implement anything else that deviates from the **Acceptance Criteria**. If you need to implement something that is not in the AC, update the AC first and then implement it or create a new task for it.

Use these workflow commands:
backlog task list -s "To Do" --plain
backlog task 42 --plain
backlog task edit 42 -a @{yourself} -s "In Progress"
backlog task edit 42 --plan "1. Analyze current implementation\n2. Identify bottlenecks\n3. Refactor in phases"
backlog task create "Refactor DB layer" -p 42 -a @{yourself} -d "Description" --ac "Tests pass,Performance improved"
backlog task edit 42 -s Done --notes "Implemented GraphQL resolver with error handling and performance monitoring"

Before completion: check all AC (`- [ ]` → `- [x]`); add `## Implementation Notes`; run tests and linting; update relevant documentation. A task is Done only when all AC are checked, the plan is followed or deviations noted, automated unit/integration tests cover new logic, linter and formatter succeed, relevant docs are updated, code is self-reviewed, status is set via CLI, and performance, security, and licence checks are green.

Task file **MUST** have an `## Implementation Notes` section added summarising your approach:
Features implemented or modified
Technical decisions and trade-offs
Modified or added files

⚠️ **IMPORTANT**: Never mark a task as Done without completing ALL items above.

CLI reference (commands shown verbatim):
Create task: `backlog task create "Add OAuth System"`
Create with description: `backlog task create "Feature" -d "Add authentication system"`
Create with assignee: `backlog task create "Feature" -a <REDACTED_USER>`
Create with status: `backlog task create "Feature" -s "In Progress"`
Create with labels: `backlog task create "Feature" -l auth,backend`
Create with priority: `backlog task create "Feature" --priority high`
Create with plan: `backlog task create "Feature" --plan "1. Research\n2. Implement"`
Create with AC: `backlog task create "Feature" --ac "Must work,Must be tested"`
Create with notes: `backlog task create "Feature" --notes "Started initial research"`
Create with deps: `backlog task create "Feature" --dep task-1,task-2`
Create sub task: `backlog task create -p 14 "Add Login with Google"`
Create (all options): `backlog task create "Feature" -d "Description" -a <REDACTED_USER> -s "To Do" -l auth --priority high --ac "Must work" --notes "Initial setup done" --dep task-1 -p 14`
List tasks: `backlog task list [-s <status>] [-a <assignee>] [-p <parent>]`
List by parent: `backlog task list --parent 42` or `backlog task list -p task-42`
View detail: `backlog task 7` (interactive UI, press 'E' to edit in editor)
View (AI mode): `backlog task 7 --plain`
Edit: `backlog task edit 7 -a <REDACTED_USER> -l auth,backend`
Add plan: `backlog task edit 7 --plan "Implementation approach"`
Add AC: `backlog task edit 7 --ac "New criterion,Another one"`
Add notes: `backlog task edit 7 --notes "Completed X, working on Y"`
Add deps: `backlog task edit 7 --dep task-1 --dep task-2`
Archive: `backlog task archive 7`
Create draft: `backlog task create "Feature" --draft`
Draft flow: `backlog draft create "Spike GraphQL"` → `backlog draft promote 3.1`
Demote to draft: `backlog task demote <id>`
Full help: `backlog --help`
<!-- BACKLOG.MD GUIDELINES END -->
